name: claude-peer
description: Proactively collaborate with Claude Code through durable no-timeout operations and persistent idle sessions as one half of a bidirectional Codex and Claude bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Unlimited Claude collaboration and reciprocal controls.
interface.longDescription: Adds both halves of a local bidirectional bridge: Codex can invoke a proactive full Claude Code agent, and an interactive Claude window can invoke a policy-bound Codex peer. Both directions queue durable operation handles, apply no bridge wall-clock timeout or idle expiry, persist clean session mappings, use unlimited follow-ups by default with optional concise bounds, and share a versioned Claude/Codex control catalog with truthful access routes.
defaultPrompt: Bring in the full Claude Code agent with Fable at max effort, verify the observed model evidence, and implement and test this with you.
Use Opus 5 at max effort for this task and report any model fallback.
Explain and verify the reciprocal Claude-to-Codex bridge and query the complete control catalog.
